description: Amass 24.245.1 — 4mm banana socket (female jack), red, straight/long-body, through-hole PCB mount. 33mm body extends well past board edge for enclosure access. Accepts standard 4mm banana plugs. 24A 1kV rated. Four mounting legs + center signal contact.
name: banana-jack-red
watch_out_for: Long-body design (33mm) — ideal for protruding through enclosure walls. Four THT mounting legs (1.3mm drill, 10.16mm square pitch) + center signal pad (2.2mm drill). 1kV/24A rating. Mates with standard 4mm banana plugs. Black variant: Amass 24.245.2 (C7437327).
